mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.gender, a.id, a.class_id, a.attendance_date, a.status FROM student s LEFT JOIN attendance a ON s.id = a.student_id AND a.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = #{status}, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO attendance (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) SELECT s.id, s.class_id, #{attendanceDate}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM student s WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance a WHERE a.student_id = s.id AND a.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} AND a.is_deleted = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS present, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `leave`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absent FROM attendance a WHERE a.class_id = #{classId} AND a.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} AND a.is_deleted = 0
